messages:
Priya: heads up—noticed a sharp CPU spike on telemetry-exporter right after the retention TTL job kicked off ~10:20UTC :eyes:
Priya: p99 processing latency jumped from ~45ms to ~420ms and exporter instances started thrashing, traced to a retain/evict wave
Jonah: can you paste the logs / queue metrics? sounds like eviction + exporter flush is amplifying batching overhead
Priya: logging snippets:
```
2026-03-19T10:20:11Z exporter[0] INFO evicting 128k spans from kv-cache
2026-03-19T10:20:11Z exporter[0] WARN flush batch_size=512 duration_ms=312 p99=420
2026-03-19T10:20:12Z exporter[0] ERROR span_submit_queue_len=32768 cpu=92%
```
Ava: yikes. eviction is causing a burst of re-serialization + prefix cache misses, so each span does more work and batching can't amortize it
Samir: what are our current batching settings? batch_timeout=20ms, max_batch=512?
Priya: current config on prod-exporter: `batch_timeout_ms=25`, `max_batch=512`, `max_concurrent_flushes=4`
Jonah: hypothesis: eviction causes a lot of tiny flushes and also inflates serialization cost per span due to tag copying. Two quick mitigations: reduce max_batch to 256 and increase max_concurrent_flushes to 8, or spread TTL jobs across shards to avoid global bursts
Ava: also consider sampling older spans before serialization: if span.age > retention_threshold - 1min, mark for drop without full marshal, that cuts CPU on eviction waves
Priya: tried a canary with max_batch=256, concurrent_flushes=8 — CPU dropped ~28% during next window, p99 down to ~160ms (not ideal but improvement)
TelemetryBot: alert: exporter_cpu_percent > 85% (2/3 instances) — auto-scaling paused due to quota throttles
Samir: quota throttles blocking autoscale is another failure mode. We should add an emergency throttle-path: if exporter_cpu > 80% and queue_len > 20k then start shedding low-priority spans and allow scale-up bypass for telemetry autoscaler
Jonah: agreed — ops proposal: (1) shard TTL sweeps to stagger evictions, (2) add cheap pre-serialize sampling on eviction path, (3) tune batching to 256/8 for bursty windows, (4) whitelist telemetry autoscaler from quota during critical windows
Ava: I'll prototype the pre-serialize sampling tweak and run a microbenchmark with realistic eviction traces
Priya: thanks. I'll schedule a short postmortem today and patch the canary to run across two regions to validate behavior under different latency profiles
Samir: note for the runbook — include steps to flip sampling and to temporarily increase exporter concurrency; also document how to split TTL job into N shards
Priya: filing follow-ups: GH issue link https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/issues/724 (will add traces + flamegraphs)
Jonah: thanks team — good progress. if anyone sees another spike ping #oncall immediately
